newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to pay $920,000 for peasant massacre.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to pay $920,000 for peasant massacre.

text.p: The Venezuelan government agreed on Wednesday to pay 343 million bolivars ($920,000) in compensation to relatives of 14 peasants killed by troops in a remote border town in 1988.
Information Minister Fernando Egana said the payment would be shared among those family members who could prove they were related to victims of the killings known locally as the "El Amparo massacre".

The compensation followed a ruling last year by the Inter- American Court of Human Rights which found the government responsible for the Oct. 29, 1988, murders in El Amparo, located about 530 miles (850 km) southwest of Caracas.
An army patrol shot the peasants after apparently mistaking them for leftist guerrillas from neighbouring Colombia.
